dataset_provenance: Cross-domain training. PlantVillage (controlled lab) + PlantDoc (CC BY 4.0, in-the-wild) mapped onto the original 38-class PlantVillage label space; optional web-collected external test images. See ml/crop_health/evaluation/cross_domain_results.json for the full experiment matrix.
notes: Field-robust ConvNeXt-Tiny selected by PlantDoc test accuracy. Serving applies 4-view TTA; single-view training metrics are preserved in single_view_metrics. Results are screening support, not a definitive diagnosis.

deployed_model_rerun.explanation: Deployed checkpoint promoted after a measured field-accuracy improvement over the previous artefact; see the candidate evaluation directory for full metrics.

tta_validation.decision: Enabled: +0.0254 field accuracy and +0.0833 low-confidence accuracy over single-view inference.

crop_prior_validation.decision: Enabled: soft crop prior uses the selected farm crop only when it maps to a trained class group; unsupported crops fall back to the unconstrained 4-view TTA result.
